Sep13 corn/soy harvest8%/6%, both ahead5y pace. Grain railcarloadsSep5 27,445, +24%y/y; bargegrain Sep12 +73%y/y. Current operating counterevidence to generalized harvest/logistics stoppage, not proof of spare or refrigerated capacity.
